title: Parquet/DuckDB pivot — the twelve-lane warehouse and its serving path
note: Chartered retroactively 2026-08-23: waves 1-3 already shipped (RUNBOOK 0.21-0.29) with no track, so the largest workstream in the repo was tracked only in prose. This records wave 4. The owner call behind it all is RUNBOOK 0.28/plantgeo-parquet-duckdb-pivot: Postgres keeps ONLY community features, every plane becomes day-partitioned Parquet on Railway storage read by DuckDB+Polars, Martin serves PMTiles. Map breakage during the transition is accepted.
shipped_before_this_track: Twelve lanes with validation, serving and forecasters (abf777f)
Lane natures, watermark-driven static lanes, conformed calendar dimension (b794e98)
Per-kind schema lookup, unblocking the five forecasters (269d299)
Zoom axis end to end + soil-survey streaming export, cap deleted (68da7af)
wave_4_scope: DONE ceeb2c9/3b7ecfb/fe32aef/68da7af/83b322f: sub-day fix, orphan-part blocker, zoom axis, soil-survey streaming, docs
d0. Completion marker on EVERY multi-part lane + audit for missing lanes (soil-field known)
d1. FUSED bulk drain + tier derivation, one pass; then stop the cron
d3. interface/http serving API -- coverage REPRODUCES getSliderCapabilities' contract
d4. Next.js repoint of the six ready tRPC procedures

partitions.note: HYPOTHESIS -- re-verify owns lists with a real grep if HEAD moved past 83b322f. d0 and d1 both touch pipeline/parquet/{objectstore,gap_fill}.py and MUST NOT run concurrently -- run d0 first, it changes the object-kind contract d1 writes through. d3/d4/d5 fan out after d1.

slices.task: Completion marker written LAST per day, required by the census, applied to EVERY multi-part lane -- not just soil-survey. Adds a third object kind to paths.py (deliberate, RUNBOOK 0.34.1). Then audit every plane/producer/geo.layers row for a missing lane; soil-field is the known one.

FUSED drain + tier derivation: bulk Postgres -> Parquet in ONE pass, each day writing base z13 and immediately deriving z9/z5/z0 from memory. Writes the new zoom layout; delete the old-layout objects. Keep the derivation transform pure and separately tested; the fusion lives in the driver. Order: build, run, THEN stop the cron.

interface/http serving API over the twelve planes: per-day, window, as-of, coverage. bbox pushdown, zoom routing, four-state envelope. Coverage REPRODUCES getSliderCapabilities' shape and stays whole-warehouse.
Repoint the six ready tRPC procedures onto parquet-plane-client.ts: drought, water-gauges, weather-observations, signal, vegetation, fire-detections. NOT soil-survey or burn-severity (no data yet).
soil-field lane: zoom-tiered, sourced from agri.spatial_cell, has NO lane today. signal_plane_day_export.sql exports cell_id with no cell geometry.

open_decisions: RESOLVED 2026-08-23: half-written release -> per-day completion marker written LAST, required by the census. Adds a THIRD object kind deliberately; the cheaper resolve_static_lane rule is blind to a container replaced mid-write, which is the normal case here. RUNBOOK 0.34.1.
RESOLVED 2026-08-23: drain and tier derivation are FUSED into one pass. RUNBOOK 0.34.2.
